item.text: I’m replacing the remaining raw component lists with a dedicated `ConnectedComponent` value object and tightening the result API around that. This will let the tests and formatter stop leaning on nested-list `toString()` output.
The component model refactor is in. I’m compiling and running the app and the regression checks now to make sure the new API shape still produces the same behavior.
Verification passed. I’m pulling the updated line references so the summary can point to the new model boundary and test coverage precisely.

Refactored the connected-components API around a real domain object instead of raw nested lists. [ConnectedComponent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ConnectedComponent.java:4) now models a single component as an immutable value, and [ConnectedComponentsResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ConnectedComponentsResult.java:5) stores `List<ConnectedComponent>` with `componentAt(...)` and `componentCount()` instead of exposing `List<List<Integer>>`.

That change simplified the rest of the code. [GraphComponentFinder.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/GraphComponentFinder.java:12) now builds `ConnectedComponent` instances directly, [ComponentFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ComponentFormatter.java:6) formats result/component objects rather than raw collections, and [ConnectedComponents.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ConnectedComponents.java:6) continues to stay thin. I also updated [ConnectedComponentsTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ConnectedComponentsTest.java:16) to assert through the new API and added immutability coverage for both the result and each component.

Verified with `javac *.java`, `java ConnectedComponents`, and `java ConnectedComponentsTest`.
